speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; please tell me, how many days old is the baby and was the delivery uncomplicated?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn (TTN).

The baby's prematurity (33 weeks) and rapid onset of distress within 2 hours of birth are classic for TTN. I will request a Chest X-Ray to confirm the presence of fluid in the airways and rule out other causes.
